observations.user_report: Ratchet remained visible and controllable while roughly half of Pokitaru was traversed without incident.

diagnosis.reason: PPSSPP reserves the 0x68xxxxxx opcode class for JIT blocks and emulator hooks. The observed 0x682BACB6 matches its MIPS_IS_EMUHACK mask, while all independent Pokitaru guards remained valid and gameplay continued.
diagnosis.not_demonstrated: The WF-002 counter remained at zero, so this run did not execute or validate the Allegrex trampoline.

v0.4.3_response: Accept a PPSSPP emuhack opcode only at wrapper prologue word zero.
Continue to require the stable level anchor, prologue words one through three, the relocated inner jal and every candidate callsite exactly.
Log the accepted JIT marker instead of exporting a false module_transition trace.
Replace the silent WF-002 probe with both LEVEL_01 WF-019 TriggeredDoor branches at reference RAs 0x092C142C and 0x092C16AC.
Keep full-module instrumentation disabled until a focused trace contains at least one hit and gameplay remains transparent.
remaining_boundary: Run v0.4.3 Stage 01 near one or more doors on Pokitaru and return status.log plus the manual trace.
